description: Personifying and making friends with scientific concepts, space missions and the stars.
summary: What if the Dawn spacecraft had a voice? In this short audiobook, Dawn tells us about her adventures on Ceres and Vesta and the remarkable engineering and science that made her discoveries possible.
details: I wanted to give the Dawn spacecraft a voice to tell its story. It's lonely orbiting Ceres for (essentially) eternity! Reading the story aloud was very important to me to give the spacecraft a personality. While not among the most famous, the Dawn mission was critical in developing the technologies and techniques for future asteroid missions, and is still the only mission to Ceres. My story is pitched at elementary to middle schoolers who did not grow up in the age of Dawn.
